topic: Coordinating a perf regression and upstream contact for the vendored data-toolkit

messages.text: Heads-up: running the benchmark on 1.4 shows a ~30% regression in the map-reduce path since the last release. Any guesses what changed?
Quick Q: who is the maintainer of the 'data-toolkit' repo we vendor? I don't have their GitHub handle — can you remind me?
Also, FYI I left some profiling logs in /tmp on my laptop if anyone wants them.
Yikes. I'll start a bisection tomorrow — could be the new serializer we merged last sprint.
We need to loop in the upstream maintainer for licensing questions — does anyone have their contact (GitHub handle or org)?
If Cara can bisect, great. Also — which upstream repo is the vendored data-toolkit at (owner/repo)? I couldn't find it in the docs.
Thanks — if we confirm license compatibility we can proceed. Also can someone draft the vendor outreach?
I'm not sure of the exact handle — I thought it was someone in infra. Worth looking up before we ping them.
Dan, quick aside: the vendor meeting got pushed to Thursday. I'll update the calendar.
Ben — if you can find the owner/repo we can ask DeepWiki for the license and contributors to confirm the maintainer.
Agree. Holding the release until we confirm licensing would be safer.
Also cc'ing the new hire in infra — they might know the vendored repo.
Agree, bisect sounds right.
